verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents an API tokens feature and JMAP supports OAuth 2.0/Bearer tokens. A community user reports using an app password restricted to SMTP-only access, which shows Fastmail can issue scope-limited credentials. However, the pack gives only the API tokens article title, with no detail on per-token scopes, read-only versus write access, or expiry. Missing for 10: documented per-scope permissions for API tokens, read-only or per-capability restrictions for JMAP access, token expiry/revocation details, agent-oriented guidance.
